release.segment_profit_definition: Segment performance is measured and resources are allocated based on a number of factors, the primary profit measure being earnings before interest and income taxes ("EBIT"), as adjusted. Segment EBIT is adjusted for special items as determined by management such as the impact of rationalization activities, certain asset impairment charges and gains or losses on disposals of assets. (2009 10-K Note 3)

other_items: Loss associated with the acquisition of Jin Tai

release.outlook_text: The Company anticipates capital expenditures in 2010 in the range of $40,000 — $50,000. (2009 10-K MD&A; no earnings release available) Venezuelan subsidiary's net Bolivar denominated monetary liability position is expected to result in a gain of approximately $2,500 during the first quarter of 2010 ... The impact of selling inventories carried at the previous exchange rate is expected to decrease gross profit by approximately $5,000.
release.notes_on_special_items: 2009 10-K: Rationalization and asset impairment charges $29,897 ($23,789 after-tax): $27,142 primarily employee severance, $2,061 long-lived asset impairments (Europe $253, Asia Pacific $1,515, Harris $293), $879 indefinite-lived intangible impairments, gain of $185 on partial settlement of a pension plan (Harris Ireland); 1,063 employees affected, two facility closures. Pension settlement gain $1,543 recorded as reduction of SG&A. Equity loss includes $7,943 loss on Jin Tai acquisition / Kuang Tai disposal (no tax benefit) and $5,667 share of gain on sale of property by Turkey JV. Segment special items 2009: NAW $10,386 rationalization; EW $9,868 rationalization, $134 intangible impairment, $(5,667) gain on property; APW $3,207 rationalization, $(1,543) pension settlement gain, $7,943 Jin Tai loss; SAW $528; HPG $5,029 rationalization, $745 intangible impairment.

notes: Q4-2009 earnings release (8-K ~Feb 2010) is not in the raw folder; release block uses the 2009 10-K (segment Note 3, MD&A sales narrative, MD&A non-GAAP reconciliation).

Original 2009 10-K did NOT present NCI separately on the income statement: income attributable to noncontrolling interests was included in SG&A (stated as not material). Hence nci_income and net_income_incl_nci are null in 'is'; IS 'Net income' 48,576 is LECO net income. The 2010 10-K recast 2009: SG&A 333,138, Operating income 93,233, pretax 86,738, NI incl NCI 48,833, NCI 257 (i.e. 257 moved out of SG&A).

cf_ytd.net_income_incl_nci = 48,576 = the CF starting line 'Net income' as originally printed (NCI earnings embedded in SG&A). Recast 2010 10-K CF starts at 48,833 and shows Other non-cash items 1,770 (vs 2,027 original).

cf_ytd.st_borrowings_net = -12,954 = Proceeds from short-term borrowings 22,241 + Payments on short-term borrowings (34,779) + Amounts due banks, net (416); this net figure is also printed in the 10-K MD&A cash-flow table as '(Payments) proceeds on short-term borrowings, net (12,954)'.
cf_ytd.pension_noncash = 'Amortization of actuarial losses and prior service costs' 25,064.

bs.short_term_debt = 'Amounts due banks'. Accrued pensions current (3,014) placed in other_current_liabilities; non-current 'Accrued taxes' (53,388) in other_noncurrent_liabilities.
Effective tax rate per 2009 10-K MD&A: 43.8% (37,905/86,481); later recast shows 43.7% on recast pretax 86,738.

Sales change FY2009: taken from 2009 10-K MD&A narrative (no table); directions ('decrease'/'increase'/'unfavorable') converted to signs; acquisitions_pct 0.0 where no acquisition contribution mentioned. Segment table (2009 10-K original): APW EBIT (27,977), special 9,607, adj (18,370); HPG EBIT (4,886), adj 888; consolidated EBIT 91,540, special 30,630, EBIT as adjusted 122,170. Later recast (2010 release / 2010 10-K) shows APW EBIT (27,841), special 9,006, adj (18,835); HPG EBIT (4,765), adj 1,009; consolidated EBIT 91,797, special 30,029, adj 121,826 (NCI reclass out of SG&A and pension settlement gain restated to 2,144 gross with 601 NCI).

Adjusted net income items are AFTER-TAX amounts as printed (no pre-tax/tax-effect split disclosed) and are placed in adj_net_income.other_items. Later recast (2010 10-K / Feb-2011 release) shows 2009 adjusted operating income 120,986 (items: rationalization 26,957; impairment 2,940; pension settlement gain (2,144)) and adjusted NI 73,098 incl. NCI 601.

Dividends declared per share 1.09 from IS / equity statement (pre-2011 split). Cash dividends paid per share 1.08 (Feb-2011 release prior-year column). In January 2010 a quarterly dividend of $0.28/share ($11,885) was paid.
ROIC for 2009 not in an original release; Feb-2011 release prior-year column shows 4.3% and net operating working capital to sales 23.2% (10-K MD&A also 23.2%).

Special items (MD&A): rationalization/impairment 29,897 pre-tax (23,789 after-tax); pension settlement gain 1,543 (in SG&A); Jin Tai acquisition loss 7,943 and Turkey JV property-sale gain 5,667 (both in equity earnings). Subsequent event: Venezuela functional currency change to USD effective 2010-01-01 and devaluation 2.15->4.30 Bolivars/USD.
Per-share and share data are pre-2-for-1 split (May 31, 2011), as originally reported.
